annotations.title: List the signatures I can send with

description: Lists the signatures the signed-in person can send email with: their own ("me", the default), their AI assistants', and company AI agents' (agents of a company they own or that acts for them) - each with id, name, how it signs (as the person or as the agent), its AI disclosure preset and a one-line preview. Pass a choice as signature to get_signature. If it is unclear which one the person wants for an email, ask them before sending. A connection bound to one agent lists only that agent.
name: list_signatures
